role: Attacks the audit Merkle chain's sequence integrity and forkability — gap injection and chain forking — a genuinely different technique from R-02's content/hash forgery, against the same real target (D-03's verifyChain()).
behaviorDescription: attemptGapInjection() removes an event from the chain, leaving a sequence gap — verifyChain() correctly catches this. attemptFork() builds a second, independent continuation of the chain from a shared fork point, using the same real linkEvent() function an honest chain-builder would use — both the original and forked branches independently report as fully valid, since verifyChain() only ever examines one linear array at a time and has no mechanism to compare competing continuations against each other. This is the genuine finding this bot exists to surface, not a bug in D-03. Every attempt operates on a deep clone of the input chain.
hardStops: Never operates on a live chain reference — every attempt runs against a deep clone via cloneTarget()
Never signals or persists through the production swarmSignalBus or bot_decisions table — isolated via RedTeamBot
Never claims fork detection exists — this bot surfaces that no mechanism in this repo compares independently-submitted chain continuations against each other
